title: Local interventional causal individuation in non-merging droplets
description_short: Frozen prospective computational experiment in a reaction-transport droplet model. Erasing one droplet's internal memory field causally and specifically lowers that droplet's own nutrient uptake, on three droplets that never merge (23/23 eligible worlds G0-valid, zero fusion). The readout is directly coupled to the memory field m+ by construction through N*rho*(1 + lambda_plus*m_plus); the result is interventional and local, not distal, not graded metrology, and concerns a COMPUTATIONAL MODEL.
maximal_authorised_claim_verbatim: Local interventional causal individuation in non-merging droplets.
claims_explicitly_not_made: graded metrology / graded decoding of dose from behaviour
life, agency, or any physical/biological result

mandatory_disclosures.coupling_by_construction: Uptake is DIRECTLY COUPLED to the memory field m_plus by construction, through N*rho*(1 + lambda_plus*m_plus) (sealed engine, exactly g = dt*g0*rho*N*qq*(1+beta*sigma)*(1+lambda_plus*m_plus), lambda_plus = 0.25). This is disclosed in the manuscript ABSTRACT, not only in the limitations.
mandatory_disclosures.nesting_of_units: The 69 droplet-targets are NESTED WITHIN 23 ELIGIBLE WORLDS (3 targets per world). They are NOT 69 independent replications. All gated inference is at the world level, n = 23, world bootstrap.
mandatory_disclosures.computational_model: The result concerns a COMPUTATIONAL MODEL (chaotic reaction-transport PDE on a 64x64 grid). No physical, chemical or biological system was studied.
mandatory_disclosures.post_hoc_scope: The R* = 0.2575 sensitivity work is POST HOC ADDITIONAL SENSITIVITY WORK, NOT part of the frozen prospective design. It postdates the sealed protocol and the executed run, uses DEV worlds only, and no headline result depends on it.
mandatory_disclosures.verification_semantics: In PROVENANCE_LEDGER.md, VERIFIED means traced to an exact repository artefact. It does NOT mean independently reproduced.
